blocking_findings: Upstream server/hub.py hard-codes HTTPServer to 127.0.0.1 inside the Docker container and ignores the existing live BIND_HOST=0.0.0.0. This makes normal host-published access fail.
The upstream IBM curl option requires QPU_HTTP_CLIENT=curl, which is absent from current .env. Task 016 forbids configuration changes, so this setting was not enabled.
Static review additionally found _curl_http builds a curl command without appending the URL or specifying stdin as the request body. This path was not executed or repaired.
